# Central Research Hub

The **Central Research Hub** serves as the primary coordination point for all interconnected research domains within the knowledge graph. It connects theoretical physics, neurobiology, distributed computing, and machine intelligence.

> [!tip] Central Hub Directive
> This hub is targeted by multiple incoming wikilinks to evaluate backlink index density and reactive graph query performance under pressure.

## Key Theoretical Domains

- [[Quantum Computing Fundamentals]] — Unitary transformations, quantum teleportation, and state spaces.
- [[Neural Network Architectures|Deep Neural Architectures]] — Transformer models, multi-head self-attention, and optimization dynamics.
- [[Synaptic Plasticity]] — Spike-timing-dependent plasticity and biological neural computation.
- [[Graph Theory and Network Topologies]] — Spectral graph theory, connectivity metrics, and scale-free networks.
- [[Astrophysics and Supernovae]] — High-energy stellar collapses and cosmic nucleosynthesis.
